title: Research across communities
description: Publication venues and research themes across the 23 works in my CV. Select a shared topic or a venue–topic connection to explore the related work.
note: Colors indicate curated venue-community groups, not rankings or exclusive discipline classifications. Topics are overlapping, title- and project-based annotations; a work can appear in multiple topic columns. Counts represent works, not citations. Gray rows distinguish dataset and preprint repositories from conference and journal venues.
